meta.purpose: Financial Markets and Investment Knowledge — a learning module, not an advisory service.

disclaimer.headline: This is education, not investment advice.
disclaimer.body: Nothing in this repository is a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any security. No output here is personalised advice, and no module should be used to make a real investment decision without independent professional advice from a SEBI-registered investment adviser. All portfolios in this module are simulated with synthetic or historical data. Educational analysis of a market is fundamentally different from investment advice: analysis explains how something works, advice applies it to your specific circumstances, risk capacity and goals under a regulated duty of care.
rules: State the source and date of every market data point.
Never present a simulated return as indicative of future performance.
Label every opinion as an opinion.
If you publish any analysis, include the educational-purpose disclaimer.

modules.name: Financial Markets — Structure and Participants
modules.outcome: Explain who does what in the Indian market and how a trade settles.
modules.practice: Trace a single equity trade from order to settlement, naming every intermediary and the regulator for each step.

modules.name: Equity Markets
topics: Corporate actions and their price effect
modules.outcome: Read a stock quote page and understand every number on it.
modules.practice: Deconstruct a listed company's price history around a corporate action and explain the adjustment.

modules.name: Debt Markets
modules.outcome: Explain why a bond's price moves when rates move, and by how much.
modules.practice: Compute price, YTM and duration for three bonds with different maturities and compare rate sensitivity.

modules.name: Money Markets
modules.outcome: Explain how short-term liquidity is priced and transferred.
modules.practice: Compute the effective yield on a 91-day T-bill and compare it with a 3-month CD.

modules.name: Capital Markets
topics: Public issue process and book building
modules.outcome: Describe how a company raises capital and what it must disclose.
modules.practice: Prepare a one-page capital-raising options comparison for a fictional ₹200 crore company.

modules.name: Mutual Funds
modules.outcome: Read a fund factsheet and identify what actually matters.
modules.practice: Compare three funds from factsheets on cost, holdings, benchmark and risk, and write a neutral comparison.

modules.name: Bonds and Fixed Income Analysis
topics: Call and put options in bonds
modules.outcome: Assess the risk in a fixed-income instrument beyond its coupon.
modules.practice: Perform a credit assessment of a fictional issuer across five parameters and state the key risk.

modules.name: Government Securities
modules.outcome: Explain how government borrowing prices the risk-free rate.
modules.practice: Plot a yield curve from three tenors and interpret its shape.

modules.name: Derivatives — Overview
modules.outcome: Explain what a derivative does and who should use it.
modules.practice: Draw and explain the payoff of four option positions and identify when each is used.
modules.deliverable: Payoff exhibit + trading vs hedging note

modules.name: Futures and Options
modules.outcome: Design a hedge for a real exposure and explain its cost.
modules.practice: Design a hedge for an exporter's 3-month USD receivable using forwards and options, and compare outcomes across three exchange-rate scenarios.

modules.name: Portfolio Management
modules.outcome: Construct a portfolio with a stated objective and explain the trade-offs.
modules.practice: Build a simulated three-asset portfolio with target weights, rebalance quarterly and attribute performance.

modules.name: Fundamental Analysis
modules.outcome: Produce a structured, evidence-based view on a business.
modules.practice: Write a two-page fundamental analysis of a listed company using only public disclosures, with a valuation range and stated limitations.

modules.name: Technical Analysis
modules.outcome: Understand the tools and their evidentiary limits.
modules.practice: Apply three indicators to a price series and write an honest assessment of what they did and did not predict.

modules.name: Risk Management
topics: Risk types: market, credit, liquidity, operational
modules.outcome: Quantify and articulate the downside of a position.
modules.practice: Compute a simple historical VaR for a simulated portfolio and run two stress scenarios.

modules.name: Investment Valuation
modules.outcome: Value an asset and defend the range.
modules.practice: Value the same business with DCF and two multiples, reconcile the answers and explain the gap.

modules.name: Financial Statement Analysis for Markets
modules.outcome: Spot the accounting signals that precede trouble.
modules.practice: Screen five fictional companies using six forensic tests and rank them by accounting risk.

projects.title: Company research report
projects.brief: A full fundamental research note on a listed company using public disclosures only.

projects.title: Simulated portfolio
projects.brief: A diversified simulated portfolio tracked for a defined period with attribution.
steps: Select 6–10 holdings with a written thesis each
Track monthly and rebalance per policy
Write a review of what you got wrong
projects.deliverable: Portfolio tracker + monthly reviews + final attribution

projects.title: Macro and market update
projects.brief: A monthly market update covering rates, equity, currency and one thematic issue.
steps: Collect data from official sources with dates
Summarise the three most important moves
State what you would watch next month

researchWorkflow: Collect primary sources (annual reports, exchange filings, regulator data)
State the answer, the confidence and the limitations
Record the thesis and revisit it at a fixed date, scoring your own accuracy
